INSERT INTO collection_materializations (
                collection_id,
                materialization_scope,
                materialization_key,
                user_id,
                rule_hash,
                rule_schema_version,
                materialization_schema_version,
                state,
                evaluated_at,
                stale_at,
                stale_reason,
                error_at,
                error_code,
                error_message,
                total_count,
                visible_count,
                updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                $1, $2::varchar, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7,
                'ready', NOW(), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, $8, $9, NOW()
            )
            ON CONFLICT (collection_id, materialization_key) DO UPDATE SET
                rule_hash = EXCLUDED.rule_hash,
                rule_schema_version = EXCLUDED.rule_schema_version,
                materialization_schema_version = EXCLUDED.materialization_schema_version,
                state = 'ready',
                evaluated_at = EXCLUDED.evaluated_at,
                stale_at = NULL,
                stale_reason = NULL,
                error_at = NULL,
                error_code = NULL,
                error_message = NULL,
                total_count = EXCLUDED.total_count,
                visible_count = EXCLUDED.visible_count,
                expires_at = NULL,
                updated_at = NOW()
            RETURNING
                id,
                state::text AS "state!",
                rule_hash,
                evaluated_at,
                expires_at,
                error_message,
                total_count,
                visible_count
